answer: The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own oasis record, and its own share of the kernel quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The comet ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 1055 identities would post 1133 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
